milestones.title: Complete the PMR upgrade of Dewan Perpaduan Kampung Semera Lot
milestones.description: The official report records the RM150,000 PMR 2025 hall upgrade as completed on 9 February, with Rodiyah witnessing its handover. Work included walls, cooling, toilets and lighting.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers this named constituency project. Maha Enterprise carried out the work and SDO coordinated implementation; the MP is not credited as sole builder. Publication was 13 February, distinct from the reported 9 February completion date.

milestones.title: Provide RM110,900 in Gawai support to 50 Lingga longhouses
milestones.description: The official report records the Batang Lupar constituency contributions, presented through Shafizan’s representative, at RM100 per longhouse door.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers the reported contribution round. Longhouse doors and recipient longhouses are different units; neither is a completion denominator. Final household distribution and use of the funds were not independently verified.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
